title: malva subovata
intro: Malva subovata, commonly known as Mallow or Dwarf Mallow, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, and its health benefits include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malva subovata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects, making it a valuable remedy for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
